summary: The recall of Reliable-1 Laboratories' Sodium Chloride Hypertonicity Ophthalmic Solution 5% (lots 3192, 3293, 3336) has been reported by U.S.-based safety tracking sites and news outlets, confirming the same batches are affected. No additional international regulator reports were found beyond these U.S. sources.
